question: Choose the misspelt word from the given options.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Opulance'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling is 'Opulence'.**
 
• The word '**Opulence**' is a **noun** that means 'great wealth or luxuriousness'. **(धन-वैभव)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The opulence of the palace took everyone’s breath away.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3 i.e. Opulance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Brilliance -** exceptional talent or intelligence **(प्रतिभा)**
 
• **Defiance -** open resistance or bold disobedience **(अवज्ञा)**
 
• **Tolerance -** the ability to endure hardship or accept differences **(सहनशीलता)**
